access_notes: Initial Scryfall requests with generic User-Agent returned 400, then succeeded with required identifying User-Agent. Lorcana base image identifiers returned 404 until the official viewer route /card was observed. Unsupported AVIF emit attempts and cropped interim browser renders were excluded; the same original cards were subsequently inspected as complete decoded images. No video or live foil behavior inspected.
